name: IT Helpdesk
charter: Handles day-to-day hardware, software, and device issues for individual employees. First line of support for anything blocking a single person's ability to work.
example_requests: My laptop won't turn on
I need a monitor replaced
My dock isn't charging my laptop

name: Network Engineering
charter: Owns office and campus network infrastructure: wifi, switches, VPN, and connectivity issues affecting more than a single device.
example_requests: Wifi keeps dropping on floor 3
VPN is unreachable from the Austin office
Conference room AV network is down

name: Data Platform
charter: Owns data warehouse access, dashboards, ETL pipelines, and analytics tooling. Handles data access requests and reporting/dashboard issues.
example_requests: The revenue dashboard shows stale numbers
I need read access to the analytics database
Can we get a new pipeline for the marketing data feed

name: Security
charter: Handles security incidents, suspected compromise, phishing, and access anomalies. Owns incident response and account lockdown decisions.
example_requests: I think I entered my password on a phishing site
I'm getting MFA prompts I didn't trigger
Someone may have accessed my account

name: Business Applications
charter: Owns internal SaaS tooling: Slack, shared drives, CRM, ticketing systems, and project-specific software provisioning.
example_requests: Set up a Slack channel and shared drive for a new project
We need a CRM instance for the new vendor
Can we get a shared calendar for onboarding

name: HR Operations
charter: Handles compensation, payroll, performance, conflict, and employee-relations matters. Any request touching pay, benefits, or personnel issues.
example_requests: My paycheck was short this month
I want to raise a concern about a manager
Question about my benefits enrollment

name: Facilities
charter: Owns physical office space: building access, desks, meeting rooms, and on-site equipment not related to IT hardware.
example_requests: My badge doesn't work on the 4th floor
We need more chairs in the east conference room
The AC on floor 2 is broken

name: Intake Review Queue
charter: Fallback queue for requests that do not clearly map to an existing team's charter. A human triages and reroutes from here.
example_requests: General requests that don't fit any specific category
Cross-functional asks spanning multiple teams
Unclear ownership requests

name: Sensitive Intake Review
charter: Guardrail destination for requests involving HR-sensitive matters (compensation, performance, conflict, termination, harassment) or legal/compliance exposure. Always routed here by policy, regardless of model suggestion, for human handling.
example_requests: Compensation or payroll disputes
Harassment or conflict reports
Contract, regulatory, or data-privacy exposure
